```{=html}
<p>In addition to other powers the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may have, and notwithstanding the provisions of any other public law, public general law, or the Baltimore City Charter, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may borrow money by issuing and selling bonds for the purpose stated in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (a)(2) of this section</a> if a request to the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore is made by both:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the owners of at least two-thirds of the assessed valuation of the real property located within the special taxing district; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>at least two-thirds of the owners of the real property located within the special taxing district, provided that:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>multiple owners of a single parcel are treated as a single owner; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>a single owner of multiple parcels is treated as one owner.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p><a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">This section</a> is self-executing and does not require the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore to enact legislation to exercise the powers granted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Payment of bonds; Application of proceeds.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Bonds shall be payable from the special fund to the extent provided in the authorizing ordinance, as set forth in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (e) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>All proceeds received from any bonds issued and sold shall be applied solely to pay the cost of infrastructure improvements, including:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>costs of design, construction, establishment, extension, alteration, or acquisition of infrastructure improvements;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>costs of issuing bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>payment of the principal and interest on loans, money advances, or indebtedness incurred by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore for any of the purposes stated in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (a)(2) of this section</a>, including the refunding of bonds previously issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>funding of a debt service reserve fund or payment of interest prior to, during, or for a limited period of time after construction.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Prerequisites for bond issuance.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Before issuing bonds, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall by ordinance:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>designate an area or areas as a special taxing district;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>subject to paragraph (2) of this subsection, create a special fund with respect to the special taxing district; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>provide for the levy of an ad valorem or special tax on all real and personal property within the special taxing district at a rate or amount designed to provide adequate revenues to pay the principal of, interest on, and redemption premium, if any, on the bonds, to replenish any debt service reserve fund, and for any other purpose related to the ongoing expenses of or security for the bonds. Ad valorem taxes shall be levied in the same manner, upon the same assessments, for the same period or periods, and as of the same date or dates of finality as are now or may hereafter be prescribed for general ad valorem tax purposes within the district, and shall be discontinued when all of the bonds have been paid in full.  Special taxes shall be levied pursuant to <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (k) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance creating a special fund under paragraph (1)(ii) of this subsection shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>pledge to the special fund the proceeds of the ad valorem or special tax to be levied as provided under paragraph (1)(iii) of this subsection;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>require that the proceeds from the tax be paid into the special fund;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>provide that assessments and taxes levied within the special taxing district may not be accelerated by reason of bond default; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>provide that the maximum special assessments, special taxes, or other fees or charges applicable to any individual property may not be increased in the event that other property owners become delinquent in the payment of a special assessment, special tax, or other fee or charge securing special obligation debt issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>In lieu of the pledge set forth in paragraph (2)(i) of this subsection, the authorizing ordinance, subject to subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph, may pledge or assign:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>all or any part of the revenues and receipts from the special taxes to the payment of principal and interest on the bonds; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>the special fund and any other fund into which all or any part of such revenues and receipts are deposited after such revenues and receipts are appropriated by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore to the payment of such principal and interest.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The revenues and receipts may not be irrevocably pledged to the payment of such principal and interest and the obligation to pay such principal and interest from such revenues and receipts shall be subject to annual appropriation by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">If bonds not outstanding; Termination of district.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>When no bonds authorized by <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> are outstanding with respect to a special taxing district and the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore by ordinance so determines, moneys in the special fund for that special taxing district created pursuant to <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (e)(1) of this section</a> may be:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>applied as provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (d) of this section</a> in accordance with the purposes set forth in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (a)(2) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>accumulated for payment of debt service on bonds subsequently issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> for any of the purposes described in subsection (a)(2) and whose proceeds are to be applied in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (d) of this section</a>; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>used to pay or to reimburse the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore for debt service which the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore is obligated to pay or has paid (whether such obligation is general or limited) on any bonds or State obligations.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may enact an ordinance creating a special fund described in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (e)(1)(ii) of this section</a> with respect to a special taxing district, even though no bonds authorized by <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> have been issued by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore with respect to that special taxing district or are then outstanding.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The taxes allocated to such special fund by <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (e)(2) of this section</a> shall thereafter be paid over to Such special fund, as long as such ordinance remains in effect.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>When no bonds authorized by <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> are outstanding with respect to a special taxing district:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the special taxing district shall be terminated; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>any moneys remaining in the special fund on the date of termination of the special taxing district shall be paid to the general fund of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Enabling ordinance.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>In order to implement the authority conferred upon it by <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> to issue bonds, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall enact an ordinance that:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>specifies and describes the proposed undertaking and states that it has complied with <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (e) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>specifies the maximum principal amount of bonds to be issued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>specifies the maximum rate or rates of interest for the bonds; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>agrees to a covenant to levy upon all real and personal property within the special taxing district ad valorem taxes or special taxes in rate and amount at least sufficient in each year in which any of the bonds are outstanding to provide for the payment of the principal of and the interest on the bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance may specify, or may authorize the Board of Finance by resolution to specify, any of the following as it deems appropriate to effect the financing of the proposed undertaking:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the actual principal amount of the bonds to be issued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the actual rate or rates of interest for the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the manner in which and the terms upon which the bonds are to be sold;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>the manner in which and the times and places that the interest on the bonds is to be paid;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>the time or times that the bonds may be executed, issued, and delivered;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>the form and tenor of the bonds and the denominations in which the bonds may be issued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>the manner in which and the times and places that the principal of the bonds is to be paid, within the limitations set forth in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>provisions pursuant to which any or all of the bonds may be called for redemption prior to their stated maturity dates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>provisions establishing sinking funds or debt service reserve funds for the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>provisions pledging other assets and revenues towards the payments of the principal of and interest on the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>provisions for municipal bond insurance or any other type of financial guaranty of the bonds; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xii)</span></p>
<p>any other provisions not inconsistent with <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> as shall be determined by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore to be necessary or desirable to effect the financing of the proposed undertaking.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Before the ordinance that designates a special taxing district, authorizes the issuance of bonds, or levies ad valorem taxes or special taxes under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> may be finally enacted, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall hold a public hearing after giving not less than 10-days notice in a newspaper of general circulation in the City of Baltimore.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance enacted pursuant to this subsection, if such bonds constitute debt of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore under <a href="article-xi.html#s-7">Article XI, § 7 of the Maryland Constitution</a>, shall be submitted to the legal voters of the City of Baltimore at the time and place specified therein.  Such ordinance shall become effective only if it is approved by the majority of the votes cast at the time and place specified in such ordinance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>Except as required by subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph, any ordinance or resolution enacted or adopted in furtherance of the ordinance enacted pursuant to this subsection, the bonds, the designation of a special taxing district, or the levy of a special ad valorem tax or special tax shall not be subject to any referendum.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance authorizing the bonds required under this subsection, any ordinance or resolution enacted or adopted in furtherance of the required ordinance, the bonds, the designation of a special taxing district, or the levy of a special ad valorem tax or special tax shall be subject to the request of the landowners as specified under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (c)(1) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>The special fund, any sinking fund established to provide for the payment of the principal of or interest on any bonds issued by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> and any proceeds of the sale of any such bonds may be invested by the fiscal officer of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore having custody of such funds, pending the expenditure thereof, in the manner prescribed under the provisions of Article 95, § 22 of the Annotated Code, as amended, replaced or supplemented from time to time, and any applicable investment policy adopted by the Board of Finance.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Tax exemption.</span></p>
<p>The principal amount of the bonds, the interest payable on the bonds, their transfer, and any income derived from the transfer, including any profit made in the sale or transfer of the bonds, shall be exempt from taxation by the State and by the counties and municipal corporations of the State.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Form; Tenor; Sale.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>All bonds may be in bearer form or in coupon form or may be registrable as to principal alone or as to both principal and interest.  Each of the bonds shall be deemed to be a security as defined in § 8-102 of the Commercial Law Article of the Annotated Code, as amended, replaced, or supplemented from time to time, whether or not it is either one of a class or series or by its terms is divisible into a class or series of instruments.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>All bonds shall be signed manually or in facsimile by the Mayor of Baltimore, and the seal of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall be affixed to the bonds and attested by the custodian of the city seal, manually or by facsimile.  If any officer whose signature or countersignature appears on the bonds ceases to be such officer before delivery of the bonds, the officer's signature or countersignature shall nevertheless be valid and sufficient for all purposes the same as if the officer had remained in office until delivery.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>All bonds shall mature not later than 40 years from their date of issuance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>All bonds shall be sold in the manner, either at public or private sale, and upon the terms as the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore by ordinance (or if authorized in the ordinance authorizing such bonds, the Board of Finance by resolution) deems best.  Any contract for the acquisition of property may provide that payment shall be made in bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Bonds as legal investments, etc.</span></p>
<p>Bonds issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> are securities:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>in which all public officers and public bodies of the State and its political subdivisions, all insurance companies, state banks and trust companies, national banking associations, savings banks, savings and loan associations, investment companies, executors, administrators, trustees, and other fiduciaries may properly and legally invest funds, including capital in the control or belonging to them; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>which may properly and legally be deposited with and received by any State or county officer or any agency or political subdivision of the State for any purpose for which the deposit of bonds or obligations of the State is now or may hereafter be authorized by law.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Special tax.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>As an alternative to levying ad valorem taxes under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may levy special taxes on property in a special taxing district to cover the cost of infrastructure improvements.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>In determining the basis for and amount of the tax, the cost of an infrastructure improvement may be calculated and levied:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>equally per front foot, lot, parcel, dwelling unit, or square foot;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>according to the value of the property as determined by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, with or without regard to improvements on the property; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>in any other reasonable manner that results in fairly allocating the cost of the infrastructure improvements.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may provide by ordinance for:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>a maximum amount to be assessed with respect to any parcel of property located within a special taxing district;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>a tax year or other date after which no further special taxes under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> shall be levied or collected on a parcel; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the circumstances under which the special tax levied against any parcel may be increased, if at all, as a consequence of delinquency or default by the owner of that parcel or any other parcel within the special taxing district.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore by ordinance may establish procedures allowing for the prepayment of special taxes under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> and may provide for exemptions, deferrals, and credits.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>Special taxes levied under this subsection shall be collected and secured in the same manner as general ad valorem taxes unless otherwise provided in the ordinance or resolution and shall be subject to the same penalties and the same procedure, sale, and lien priority in case of delinquency as is provided for general ad valorem taxes.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(l)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Consent of governing body.</span></p>
<p>Before the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may designate an area wholly or partly within any county or municipal corporation as a special taxing district, the governing body of such county or municipal corporation must give its consent to the designation.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(m)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">No pledge of full faith and credit.</span></p>
<p>Bonds issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> are a special obligation of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore and may not constitute a general obligation debt of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or a pledge of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore's full faith and credit or taxing power.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(n)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Required contract disclosures.</span></p>
<p>A contract to sell real property within a special taxing district must disclose to the buyer any special assessment, special tax, or other fee or charge for which the buyer would be liable due to the special taxing district.  A seller's failure to provide the disclosure required under this subsection renders the contract voidable at the option of the buyer before the date of settlement.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(o)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Liens on property.</span></p>
<p>A lien attaches to property within a special taxing district to the extent of that property owners' obligation under any special taxing district financing.  Before any bonds are issued, a declaration encumbering all real property located in the special taxing district to the extent of such financing shall be recorded in the land records of Baltimore City and have the same priority as City taxes under State and City law.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(p)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City property leased to another.</span></p>
<p>Whenever the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, as lessor, leases its property within the special taxing district, the property shall be assessed and taxed in the same manner as privately owned property, and the lease or contract shall provide that the lessee shall pay taxes or payments in lieu of special taxes upon the assessed value of the entire property and not merely the assessed value of the leasehold interest.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(q)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Refunding bonds.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, acting by and through the Board of Finance thereof, is hereby authorized and empowered to issue its bonds for the purpose of refunding any bonds authorized to be issued under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> by payment at maturity or the purchase or redemption of bonds in advance of maturity.  The validity of any refunding bonds shall in no way be dependent upon or related to the validity or invalidity of the bonds being refunded.  Such refunding bonds may be issued by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, acting by and through the Board of Finance thereof, for the purpose of providing it with funds to pay any of its outstanding bonds authorized to be issued under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> at maturity, to purchase in the open market any of its outstanding bonds authorized to be issued under the provisions of this subsection prior to their maturity, to redeem prior to their maturity any outstanding bonds which are, by their terms, redeemable, to pay interest on any outstanding bonds prior to their payment at maturity or purchase or redemption in advance of maturity, or to pay any redemption or purchase premium in connection with the refunding of any of its outstanding bonds authorized to be issued under the provisions of this subsection.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> may be issued for the public purpose of:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>realizing savings to Baltimore City in the aggregate cost of debt service on either a direct comparison or present value basis; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>debt restructuring that:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>in the aggregate effects such a reduction in the cost of debt service; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>is determined by the Board of Finance or the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore to be in the best interest of Baltimore City, to be consistent with Baltimore City’s long-term financial plan, and to realize a financial objective of Baltimore City, including, without limitation, improving the relationship of debt service to a source of payment such as taxes, assessments, or other charges.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> may be issued in whatever principal amount shall be required to achieve the purpose for the issuance of the refunding bonds, which amount may be in excess of the principal amount of the bonds refunded or the maximum principal amount of bonds authorized to be issued under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (g)(2)(i) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> may be issued to mature on such dates and in such amounts as the Board of Finance may determine; provided that the entire principal amount represented by the refunding bonds shall be discharged not more than 40 years from the date of issuance of the bonds being refunded.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> may be sold at public sale by the solicitation of competitive bids or at private (negotiated) sale without advertisement or solicitation of competitive bids, for a price or prices which may be at, above, or below the par value of the refunding bonds, as determined by resolution of the Board of Finance of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore.  If the Board of Finance determines to sell the refunding bonds at public sale, the refunding bonds shall be sold to the highest responsible bidder or bidders therefor after due notice of such sale, but the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, acting by and through the Board of Finance thereof, shall have the right to reject any or all bids therefor for any reason.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> shall bear interest at such rate or rates as may be determined by the Board of Finance of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, which rate or rates may be fixed or variable or as determined by a method approved by the Board of Finance, and such interest shall be payable at such time or times as may be determined by the Board of Finance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>The proceeds of the sale of any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>, after the payment of issuance costs relating thereto, shall be set aside by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore as a separate trust fund to be used solely for the purposes stated in this subsection.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the powers granted in, the limitations and obligations imposed by, and the procedures specified in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> with respect to the issuance of bonds shall be applicable to the issuance of refunding bonds.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>Any refunding bonds authorized to be issued and sold under the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> shall not be subject to any debt policy limitation that may from time to time be established by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(r)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers supplemental.</span></p>
<p>The powers granted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a> shall be regarded as supplemental and additional to powers conferred by other laws, and may not be regarded as in derogation of any powers now existing.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(s)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Liberal construction.</span></p>
<p><a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">This section</a>, being necessary for the welfare of the City of Baltimore and of its residents, shall be liberally construed to effect the purpose stated in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">subsection (a)(2) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(t)</span></p>
<p>In addition to the powers in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may use the authority granted to a  political subdivision for tax increment financing in a sustainable community as provided for in <a href="article-gec.html">Title 12, Subtitle 2 of the Economic Development Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(u)</span></p>
<p>In addition to the powers in <a href="article-ii.html#s-62a">this section</a>, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may use the authority granted to a political subdivision for tax increment financing in a Regional Institution Strategic Enterprise zone as provided for in <a href="article-gec.html">Title 12, Subtitle 2 of the Economic Development Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>.</p>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 626, Acts of 2001; Ch. 510, Acts of 2005; Ch. 544, Acts of 2008; Ch. 624, Acts of 2013; Chs. 530 and 531, Acts of 2014</p>
```


### § (63). Community Benefits District Authorities. {#s-63}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>To establish, by ordinance, community benefits district management authorities, including the Charles Village Community Benefits District and the Midtown Community Benefits District, within the City to provide services consistent with paragraph (2) of this subsection to the business interests and residents of the proposed district.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>To establish community benefits district management authorities to promote and market districts, provide supplemental security and maintenance services, provide amenities in public areas, provide park and recreational programs and functions, and after an authority is established, other services and functions as requested by the authority and approved through an ordinance by the Mayor and City Council.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>To provide that community benefits district management authorities shall be proposed by the Board of Estimates of Baltimore City and approved through an ordinance by the Mayor and City Council.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Charles Village Community Benefits District.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the Charles Village Community Benefits District Management Authority shall specify and modify the boundaries of the district, but in no event shall the district be outside of the lines, as follows:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>on the south, a line beginning at the intersection of the center lines of 20th Street and Howard Street, running east along the center line of 20th Street to the center line of Guilford Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of Guilford Avenue to the center line of 25th Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>running east along the center line of 25th Street to the center line of Loch Raven Boulevard; then running northeast along the centerline of Loch Raven Boulevard to the center line of the tracks of the CSX Railroad (approximately 500 feet north of 25th Street); then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of the CSX railroad tracks to the center line of Greenmount Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of Greenmount Avenue to the center line of Old York Road; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of Old York Road to the center line of 43rd Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of 43rd Street to the center line of Greenmount Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Greenmount Avenue to the center line of 33rd Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of 33rd Street to the center line of Charles Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Charles Street to the center line of 29th Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of 29th Street to the center line of Howard Street; then running south along the center line of Howard Street to the center line of 26th Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xii)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of 26th Street to the center line of Huntingdon Avenue; then running south along the center line of Huntingdon Avenue to the center line of 25th Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiii)</span></p>
<p>running east along the center line of 25th Street to the center line of Howard Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiv)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Howard Street to the center line of 24th Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xv)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of 24th Street to the center line of Huntingdon Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xvi)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Huntingdon Avenue to the center line of 23rd Street; then running west along the center line of 23rd Street to the center line of Huntingdon Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xvii)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Huntingdon Avenue to the center line of 21st Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xviii)</span></p>
<p>running east along the center line of 21st Street to the center line of Howard Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xix)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Howard Street to the center line of 20th Street (point of origin).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Notwithstanding paragraph (1) of this subsection, the Charles Village Community Benefits District may include properties binding on either side of a street or the CSX railroad tracks where they comprise part of the boundaries under this subsection.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Scope of establishing ordinance.</span></p>
<p>An ordinance establishing a community benefits district management authority shall address the following:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>specify the powers and functions within the limits of <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>, which may be exercised and conducted by the Authority and the amount of taxes or charges which may be imposed on properties in the district.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>specify the duration of the Authority and define the boundaries of the district.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>provide for the imposition and collection of the taxes or charges and for disbursement of the revenue therefrom to the Authority.  The financial plan of the Authority, including its annual budget and its tax rate and schedule of charges, shall be subject to approval by the Board of Estimates.  Taxes and charges imposed under this paragraph may not exceed those proposed by the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>determine the organization and method of initial appointment of officers and board members of the Authority.  The majority of the members of the board shall be owners or representatives of owners of properties in the district that are subject to taxes or charges under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>.  A voting member of the board must be eligible to vote in the election under subsection (j) {subsection (k)} of <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>determine what classes of property in the district owned by public service companies as defined in <a href="article-78.html">Article 78 of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a> {now, Public Utility Companies Article} shall be subject to or exempt from taxes or charges under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers of Authority.</span></p>
<p>As provided by ordinance, the Authority may have the power:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>to be a special tax district and to conduct the functions which are assigned to it by the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>to acquire, hold and use property necessary to achieve its purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>to make contracts;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>to sue and be sued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>to borrow and accept grants for purposes consistent with the purposes of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>to employ and discharge personnel to carry out its public purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>to propose in its annual budget the taxes or charges on properties within the district. Property that is exempt under State law from ordinary property taxes shall be exempt from taxes or charges assessed to support the Authority.  Before adopting its proposed budget and making its recommendations to the City, an Authority shall hold a public hearing on taxes or charges proposed for the district.  The Authority shall publish notice of the hearing in a newspaper of general circulation in Baltimore City at least once a week for 3 consecutive weeks before the hearing;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>to adopt, amend and modify bylaws, all of which shall be subject to the approval of the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>to establish and elect officers and provide for their terms and duties;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>to contract for and purchase goods and services, without being subject to the City requirements regarding wage scales, competitive bidding or other local procurement laws.  However, the Authority shall be subject to City ordinances and City policy requiring achievement of goals regarding minority and women’s business enterprises; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(11)</span></p>
<p>to do all things necessary or convenient to carry out its powers.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Limitations.</span></p>
<p>An Authority created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> may not:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>exercise any police or general powers other than those authorized by State law and City ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>pledge the full faith or credit of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>impose taxes or charges in excess of those approved by the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>exercise the power of eminent domain;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>extend its life without the approval of the City Council;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>except as otherwise provided by law, engage in competition with the private sector;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>except as otherwise provided in subsection (i) {subsection (j)} of <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>, revert charges or taxes collected pursuant to <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> to the General Fund of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>be an agency of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland{,} and its officers and employees may not act as agents or employees of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>employ individuals who reside outside the City of Baltimore; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>except as required or appropriate to facilitate its normal operations, incur debt.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Considerations.</span></p>
<p>In adopting an ordinance, the City Council shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>give consideration to the views of the property owners, the retail merchants, the property tenants, and the other members of the business and residential communities within the district;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that a district created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> will reflect a diverse mix of business and residential properties; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that a district created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> will reflect a diverse economic, social, and racial mix.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Periodic review — General.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council shall review the effectiveness and desirability of continuing the existence of any district established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> every 4 years from the enactment of the ordinance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Periodic review — Specific.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council shall review and determine the desirability of continuing the existence of each community benefits district established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> every 4 years:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>beginning with the first meeting of the Mayor and City Council in December 2001 for the Charles Village Community Benefits District, Management Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>beginning with the first meeting of the Mayor and City Council in December, 2003 for the Midtown Community Benefits District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>beginning 4 years after the date of the establishment of any other community benefits district created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>If the continuing existence of a community benefits district is not approved:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the district shall cease to exist at the end of the City’s fiscal year in which approval was not granted; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the District Management Authority shall continue its existence only as long as necessary to terminate operations in a reasonable manner and to arrange for the disposition of all funds not needed to satisfy outstanding obligations and reserves for uncertain obligations and liabilities.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City not to reduce services.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may not permit a reduction in the services provided by the City in a district due to the establishment of a community benefits district management authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Dissolution.</span></p>
<p>In the event of a dissolution of a community benefits district, any unspent funds shall revert back to the City’s General Fund.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Approval by affected voters.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance adopted pursuant to <a href="article-ii.html#s-63">this section</a> shall take effect only if approved by 58% of the aggregate votes cast in a special election by the affected voters.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance shall provide criteria for the eligibility of voters for purposes of the election required by this subsection.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance shall provide procedures for a special election as required in this subsection, which may be administered by write-in ballots.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 732, Acts of 1994; Ch. 3, Acts of 1995; Ch. 10, Acts of 1996; Ch. 655, Acts of 1997; Ch. 89, Acts of 2000; Ch. 475, Acts of 2003; Chs. 226 and 227, Acts of 2018</p>
```


### § (64). “Child First” Authority. {#s-64}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<p>To establish by ordinance an authority known as “Child First” that uses existing facilities for the purpose of providing recreational, cultural, and other enrichment programs for children.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Nature of Authority.</span></p>
<p>The Authority established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-64">this section</a>:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>is an independent unit of the Baltimore City government;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>shall have those powers and duties consistent with the purposes of the Authority, delegated through the ordinance that the City itself could otherwise exercise; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>is exempt from those laws or procedures that would otherwise apply to any unit of the Baltimore City government to the extent exempted by the ordinance.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers of Authority.</span></p>
<p>The Authority established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-64">this section</a>:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>shall have a management board and executive director as prescribed in the ordinance adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-64">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>may sue or be sued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>may acquire, lease, or hold property for the purposes of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>may incur limited obligation debt that shall be an obligation solely of the Authority if authorized by the ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>may employ staff or contract for any services necessary to carry out the purposes of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>may adopt bylaws and regulations concerning the operation of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>may establish fees necessary for the operation of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>may make contracts of any kind and execute any instrument necessary to carry out the purposes of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>may accept from any public or private entity grants or other revenue necessary to carry out the purposes of the Authority; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>shall have any additional powers granted under and subject to the ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-64">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City funding and services.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and the City Council are authorized to provide funding for the Authority and any services through the City government that are deemed appropriate to assist the Authority in its operations.</p>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 642, Acts of 1996</p>
```


### § (65). Land Bank Authority. {#s-65}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Definitions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<p>In <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> the following words have the meanings indicated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>
            Authority”
          </p>
<p>“Authority” means a nonprofit or quasi-governmental entity created by Baltimore City under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">subsection (c) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Board.</span></p>
<p>“Board” means the Board of Directors of the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Bond.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>“Bond” means a bond issued by the Authority under this subtitle.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>“Bond” includes a bond, a refunding bond, a note, and any other obligation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Cost.</span></p>
<p>“Cost” includes:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the purchase price of property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the cost to acquire any right, title, or interest in property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the cost of any improvements made to property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>the amount to be paid to discharge each obligation necessary or desirable to vest title to any part of property in the Authority or other owner;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>the cost of any property, right, easement, franchise, and permit associated with a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>the cost of labor, machinery, and equipment necessary to implement a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>financing charges;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>interest and reserves for principal and interest and for improvements;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>the cost of revenue and cost estimates, engineering and legal services, plans, specifications, studies, surveys, and other expenses necessary or incident to determining the feasibility or practicability of a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>administrative expenses; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>other expenses as necessary or incident to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>financing a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>acquiring and improving a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>placing a project in operation, including reasonable provision for working capital; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>operating and maintaining a project.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Finance.</span></p>
<p>“Finance” includes refinance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Project.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>“Project” means any organized plan carried out by the Authority in relation to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>acquiring and rehabilitating abandoned and dilapidated properties; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>marketing and leasing or selling the rehabilitated properties.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>“Project” includes:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>acquiring land or an interest in land;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>acquiring structures, equipment, and furnishings located on a property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>acquiring property that is functionally related and subordinate to a project; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>obtaining or contracting for any services necessary for the rehabilitation of a property.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Revenues.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>“Revenues” means the income, revenue, and other money the Authority receives from or in connection with a project and all other income of the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>“Revenues” includes grants, rentals, rates, fees, and charges.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Tax sale property.</span></p>
<p>“Tax sale property” means property or an interest in property sold by the tax collector of Baltimore City in accordance with Title 14, Subtitle 8, Part III of the Tax - Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Trust agreement.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>“Trust agreement” means an agreement entered into by the Authority to secure a bond.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>“Trust agreement” may include a bond contract, bond resolution, or other contract with or for the benefit of a bondholder.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Construction of section.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p><a href="article-ii.html#s-65">This section</a> shall be liberally construed to accomplish its purposes.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The powers granted to the Authority under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> shall be construed as supplemental and in addition to powers granted to the Authority under any State or local law.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p><a href="article-ii.html#s-65">This section</a> does not authorize the Authority to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>exercise the power of eminent domain; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>levy any tax or special assessment.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Establishment of Authority.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>By ordinance, Baltimore City may establish a land bank authority in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance adopted under paragraph (1) of this subsection shall include proposed articles of incorporation of the Authority that state:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the name of the Authority, which shall be “Land Bank Authority of Baltimore City”;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>that the Authority is formed under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the names, addresses, and terms of office of the initial members of the Board of</p>
<p>Directors of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>the address of the principal office of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>the purposes for which the Authority is formed; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>the powers of the Authority subject to the limitations on the powers of the Authority under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor of Baltimore City, or any official designated in the ordinance establishing the Authority, shall execute and file the articles of incorporation of the Authority for recordation with the State Department of Assessments and Taxation.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>When the State Department of Assessments and Taxation accepts the articles of incorporation for recordation, the Authority becomes a body politic and corporate and an instrumentality of Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>Acceptance of the articles of incorporation for recordation by the State Department of Assessments and Taxation is conclusive evidence of the formation of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>By ordinance, Baltimore City may adopt an amendment to the articles of incorporation of the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>Articles of amendment may contain any provision that lawfully could be contained in articles of incorporation at the time of the amendment.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The articles of amendment shall be filed for recordation with the State Department of Assessments and Taxation.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>The articles of amendment are effective as of the time the State Department of Assessments and Taxation accepts the articles for recordation.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>Acceptance of the articles of amendment for recordation by the State Department of Assessments and Taxation is conclusive evidence that the articles have been lawfully and properly adopted.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Subject to the provisions of this subsection and any limitations imposed by law on the impairment of contracts, Baltimore City, in its sole discretion, by ordinance may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>set or change the structure, organization, procedures, programs, or activities of the Authority; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>terminate the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>On termination of the Authority:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>title to all property of the Authority shall be transferred to and shall vest in Baltimore City; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>all obligations of the Authority shall be transferred to and assumed by Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Establishment of Board of Directors.</span></p>
<p>An ordinance that creates a Land Bank Authority shall establish a Board of Directors to govern the Authority and shall include provisions for:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>appointment procedures;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>term lengths;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>removal procedures;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>election of a chair; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>powers of the Board.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Authority’s powers – General.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Except as limited by the Authority’s articles of incorporation, the Authority has all the powers set forth in <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>adopt bylaws for the conduct of business of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>sue and be sued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>maintain an office at a place the Authority designates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>borrow money;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>issue bonds and other obligations for any corporate purpose in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or an ordinance adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>invest money of the Authority in instruments, obligations, securities, or property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>enter into contracts and execute the instruments or agreements necessary or convenient to carry out <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or an ordinance adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> to accomplish their purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>solicit and accept gifts, grants, loans, or other assistance in any form from any public or private source, subject to the provisions of <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or any ordinance adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>participate in any way in a program of the federal government, the State, a political subdivision of the State, or an intergovernmental entity created under the laws of the State;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>contract for goods and services;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>study, develop, and prepare reports or plans to assist in the Authority’s exercise of powers and to monitor and evaluate the Authority’s progress;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xii)</span></p>
<p>contract with public or private entities for the provision of services necessary for the management and operation of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiii)</span></p>
<p>provide acquisition, management, and sale services to Baltimore City for City- owned property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiv)</span></p>
<p>create, own, control, or be a member of a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or other person, whether operated for profit or not for profit, for the purposes of developing property in order to maximize marketability;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xv)</span></p>
<p>exercise a power usually possessed by a private corporation in performing similar functions unless to do so would conflict with State law; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xvi)</span></p>
<p>do all things necessary or convenient to carry out the powers expressly granted by <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or by an ordinance adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may delegate to a member or officer a power granted to the Authority by <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>, including the power to execute a bond, obligation, certificate, deed, lease, mortgage agreement, or other document or instrument.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Authority’s powers – Acquisition, etc., of real property.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>acquire, directly or through a person or governmental entity, by gift, devise, transfer, exchange, foreclosure, purchase, or otherwise on terms and conditions and in a manner the Authority considers proper, real property or rights or interests in real property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>own in the Authority’s name property acquired by or conveyed to the Authority by the State, a local government, an intergovernmental agency created under the laws of this State, or any other public or private person, including tax foreclosed property and property without clear title;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>sell, lease as lessor, transfer, and dispose of the Authority’s property or interest in property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
```
