```{=html}
<p>procure insurance against loss in connection with the property, assets, or activities of the Authority; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>execute deeds, mortgages, contracts, leases, purchases, or other agreements regarding the property of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Property purchased, owned, or sold under this subsection may not be located outside of Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Staff and consultants.</span></p>
<p>The Authority may employ staff and retain consultants as employees or agents that the Authority considers necessary and set their compensation.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Appointment as receiver.</span></p>
<p>The court may appoint the Authority to serve as a receiver in a receivership proceeding filed by Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Code of ethics; Policies and procedures; Open government.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>adopt a code of ethics for the Authority’s directors, officers, and employees;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>establish policies and procedures requiring the disclosure of relationships that may give rise to a conflict of interest, including requiring that any member of the Board with a direct or indirect interest in a matter before the Authority disclose the member’s interest to the Board before the Board takes any action on the matter; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>comply with the State Open Meetings Act under <a href="article-gsg.html">Title 10, Subtitle 5 and Subtitle 6, Part III of the State Government Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a> {i.e., the State Open Meetings Act, Title 3 of the State General Provisions Article, and the State Public Information Act, Title 4 of the State General Provisions Article}.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Except as otherwise provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or the ordinance establishing an Authority, the procedures of Baltimore City control any matter relating to the internal administration of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers at tax sale; Immunities.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may exercise the powers granted to Baltimore City under §§ 14-825 through 14-831 of the Tax - Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may have the same immunities as Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Property rights.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>With respect to property held or owned by the Authority, the Authority may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>grant or acquire a license, easement, or option;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>fix, charge, and collect rents, fees, and charges for use of the property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>pay taxes or special assessments due;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>take any action, provide any notice, or institute any proceeding required to clear or quiet title in order to establish ownership by and vest title to property in the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>abate violations of the local and State building, fire, health, and related codes; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>hold, manage, maintain, operate, repair, lease as lessor, secure, prevent the waste or deterioration of, demolish, and take all other actions necessary to preserve the value of the property it holds or owns.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall be made a party to, and shall defend any action or proceeding concerning, claims against property held by the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(l)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Property inventory, classification; Recording fee exemption.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Property held by the Authority shall be inventoried and classified according to title status and suitability for use.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>A register of deeds in Baltimore City may not charge a fee to record a document evidencing the transfer under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> of property to the Authority by the State or Baltimore City.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(m)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Tax delinquent properties.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Following an unsuccessful attempt on the part of Baltimore City to collect outstanding liens at tax sale and subject to the approval of the tax collecting unit of Baltimore City, the Authority may accept from a person with an interest in a parcel of tax delinquent property or tax sale property a deed or assignment conveying that person’s interest in the property instead of:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the foreclosure or sale of the property for delinquent taxes, penalties, and interest, as defined by § 14-80l(c) of the Tax - Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>delinquent specific taxes levied by a local taxing jurisdiction.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Except as otherwise provided by law, conveyance of property by deed instead of foreclosure under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> may not affect or impair any other lien against the property or any existing recorded or unrecorded interest in the property, including:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>future installments of special assessments;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>liens recorded by the State;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>easements or rights-of-way;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>private deed restrictions;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>security interests and mortgages; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>tax liens of other taxing jurisdictions that do not consent to a release of their liens.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>A tax lien against property held by or under the control of the Authority may be released or abated at any time by one or more of the following:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Baltimore City with respect to a lien held by Baltimore City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the governing body of any taxing jurisdiction other than the State, county, or municipal corporation with respect to a lien held by the taxing jurisdiction;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>a public water or sewer authority with respect to a tax lien or right to collect a tax held by the public water or sewer authority; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>the State Comptroller with respect to a State tax lien.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(n)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Money from property redemption or sale.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Money received by the Authority as payment of taxes, penalties, or interest, or from the redemption or sale of property subject to a tax lien of any taxing unit shall be returned to the local tax collecting unit in the jurisdiction where the property is located for distribution on a pro rata basis to the appropriate taxing units in an amount equal to delinquent taxes, penalties, and interest owed on the property.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Proceeds received by the Authority may be retained by the Authority for the purposes of <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>, unless otherwise designated by:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p><a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the provisions of a deed;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>any other law; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>an agreement of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(o)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Exemption from taxes or assessments.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Except as provided in paragraph (2) of this subsection, the Authority is exempt from any requirement to pay State or local taxes or assessments on the Authority’s properties, activities, or any revenue from the properties or activities.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Property that the Authority sells or leases to a private entity is subject to State and local property taxes from the time of the sale or lease.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The principal of and interest on bonds, the transfer of bonds, and any income derived from the bonds, including profits made on their sale or transfer, are forever exempt from all State and local taxes.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(p)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Civil actions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may bring a civil action to prevent, restrain, or enjoin the waste of or unlawful removal of any property from real property held by the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall be made a party to any action or proceeding instituted for the purpose of setting aside title to property held by the Authority or for the sale of property by the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>A hearing in any such proceeding may not be held until the Authority is served in accordance with the Maryland Rules.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(q)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Public and governmental function and purpose.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Property of the Authority is public property devoted to an essential public and governmental function and purpose.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Income of the Authority is considered to be for a public and governmental purpose.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(r)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Local laws.</span></p>
<p>The Authority is subject to any local:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>zoning laws;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>permitting processes for construction, demolition, or repair of a property; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>land use controls.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(s)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Annual reports.</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall report annually to the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore City and, in accordance with <a href="article-gsg.html#s-2-1246">§ 2-1246 of the State Government Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>, the General Assembly on the activities of the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(t)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Power to issue bonds.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may periodically:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>issue bonds to pay all or part of the cost of acquiring or improving property;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>fund or refund those bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>purchase bonds with any funds available; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>hold, pledge, cancel, or resell bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>By resolution, the Authority may authorize the chair, one of the Authority’s members, or a committee of the members to determine or provide for any matters relating to bonds that the Authority considers appropriate, including:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>specifying, determining, prescribing, and approving matters, documents, and procedures that relate to the authorization, sale, security, issuance, delivery, and payment of and for the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>creating security for the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>providing for the administration of bond issues; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>taking other actions it considers appropriate concerning the bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The power granted in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph is in addition to powers conferred on the Authority by <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> and does not limit any power of the Authority under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>Subject to subsubparagraph 2 of this subparagraph, the Authority may authorize the Executive Director to take any of the actions described in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>If the Authority authorizes the Executive Director to take any of the actions described in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph, the Authority shall prescribe limits within which the Executive Director may exercise discretion.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may issue the bonds at one time or in one or more series from time to time.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>For each issue of the Authority’s bonds, the Authority shall pass a resolution that:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>specifies and describes the project for which the proceeds of the bond issuance are intended;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>generally describes the public purpose and the financing transaction to be accomplished;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>specifies the maximum principal amount of the bonds that may be issued by the Authority; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>imposes any terms or conditions on the issuance and sale of the bonds that the Authority considers appropriate.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>Subject to any provisions for their registration, bonds are negotiable instruments for all purposes regardless of whether they are payable from a special fund.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The bonds may be:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>serial bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>term bonds; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>both in the discretion of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>Subject to any delegation under paragraph (l)(ii) of this subsection, the resolution authorizing bonds may provide:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>the dates of the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>the maturity dates of the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>the interest rates on the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>the time at which the bonds will be payable;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">5.</span></p>
<p>the denominations of the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">6.</span></p>
<p>whether the bonds will be in coupon or registered form;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">7.</span></p>
<p>any registration privileges of the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">8.</span></p>
<p>the manner of execution of the bonds;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">9.</span></p>
<p>the place at which the bonds will be payable; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">10.</span></p>
<p>any terms of redemption of the bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The bonds shall mature within a period not to exceed 50 years after the date of issue.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>The bonds shall be payable in United States currency.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall sell the bonds at competitive or negotiated sale in a manner and for a price the Authority determines to be in the Authority’s best interests.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>Bonds are exempt from §<a href="article-gsf.html#s-8-206">§ 8-206 and 8-208 of the State Finance and Procurement Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>An officer’s signature or facsimile on a bond remains valid even if the officer leaves office before the bond is delivered.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>Pending preparation of the definitive bonds, the Authority may issue interim receipts or certificates that will be exchanged for definitive bonds.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>A trust agreement authorizing bonds may contain provisions that are part of the contract with the bondholders.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The provisions may include:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>pledging the following to secure payment of bonds, subject to any existing agreements with bondholders:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">A.</span></p>
<p>the full faith and credit of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">B.</span></p>
<p>revenues of a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">C.</span></p>
<p>a revenue-producing contract the Authority has made with a person or public entity; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">D.</span></p>
<p>the proceeds of the sale of bonds;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>the rates, rentals, fees, and other charges, the amounts to be raised in each year, and the use and disposition of the revenues;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>the setting aside of reserves and sinking funds and their disposition;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">4.</span></p>
<p>limits on the right of the Authority or the Authority’s agents to restrict and regulate the use of a project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">5.</span></p>
<p>limits on the purpose to which the proceeds of sale of bonds may be applied;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">6.</span></p>
<p>limits on issuing additional bonds and refunding bonds and the terms under which additional bonds may be issued and secured;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">7.</span></p>
<p>the procedure to amend or abrogate the terms of a contract with bondholders and the requirements for consent;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">8.</span></p>
<p>limits on the amount of project revenues to be expended for operating, administrative, or other expenses of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">9.</span></p>
<p>the acts or omissions that constitute default by the Authority and the rights and remedies of the bondholders in the event of a default;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">10.</span></p>
<p>the conveyance or mortgaging of a project and its site to secure the bondholders; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">11.</span></p>
<p>the creation and disposition of a collateral fund for the purpose of securing the bondholders.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>The members of the Authority and a person executing the bonds may not be held liable personally on the bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(u)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Trust agreements.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The corporate trustee under a trust agreement may be a trust company or a bank that has the powers of a trust company in or outside the State.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>An expense incurred in carrying out the trust agreement or a resolution may be treated as part of the cost of the operation of a project.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Authority’s bond determinations conclusive.</span></p>
<p>Notwithstanding any other provision of <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>, in a proceeding involving the validity or enforceability of a bond or the security for a bond, the determination of the Authority under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> is conclusive and binding.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(w)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Bonds as securities.</span></p>
<p>Bonds are securities:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>in which any of the following persons may legally and properly invest moniey, including capital that the person owns or controls:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>an officer or unit of the State or a political subdivision;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>a bank, trust company, savings and loan association, investment company, or other person conducting a banking business;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>an insurance company, insurance association, or other person conducting an insurance business;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>a personal representative, guardian, trustee, or other fiduciary; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>any other person; and</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>that may be deposited with and received by a unit of the State or a political subdivision of the State for any purpose for which the deposit of bonds or obligations of the State is authorized by law.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Bonds not debt or liability of State.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>A bond is not:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>a debt or liability of the State or a political subdivision of the State; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>a pledge of the faith and credit of the State or a political subdivision of the State.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Each bond shall state on the face of the bond that neither the State nor a political subdivision of the State is obliged to pay the principal of or interest on the bond except from revenues pledged to the payment of the bond.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The issuance of bonds does not directly, indirectly, or contingently obligate the State or its political subdivisions:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>to levy or pledge a tax to pay the bonds; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>to make an appropriation to pay the bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>Nothing in <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> prohibits the Authority from pledging its full faith and credit in connection with the issuance of bonds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(y)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Authority’s powers related to projects.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>fix and collect rates, rents, fees, and charges related to a project and for the services related to a project; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>contract with any person or governmental entity to exercise its authority under this subsection.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The rates, rents, fees, and charges established by the Authority under this subsection shall be fixed and adjusted so that the aggregate amount of the rates, rents, fees, and charges from the project, when added to other available money, is sufficient to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>pay for the expenses of the project;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>pay the principal of and the interest on the bonds that the Authority issued for the project as they become due and payable; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>create and maintain reserves required or provided for in a trust agreement.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The rates, rents, fees, and charges established by the Authority under this subsection are not subject to supervision or regulation by any unit of the State other than the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(z)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Pledge of revenues.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Any pledge of revenues and other money under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">subsection (t)(9) of this section</a> is valid and binding from the time the pledge is made.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>The revenue or money that the Authority pledges and receives is subject immediately to the lien of the pledge.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>Neither physical delivery of the revenue or money nor any other act is required to validate the lien.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The lien of the pledge is valid and binding against each party with a claim against the Authority in tort, contract, or otherwise, regardless of whether the party has notice of the lien.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The trust agreement and any other agreement or lease creating a pledge under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> need not be filed or recorded, except in the records of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(aa)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Revenues are trust funds.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Proceeds from the sale of bonds and other revenues received under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> are trust funds to be held and applied solely as provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Each officer, bank, or trust company that receives trust money from the Authority under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> shall act as trustee of the money and shall hold and apply the money for the purposes specified under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The officer, bank, or trust company holding money is subject to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>any regulation adopted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a>; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>the resolution authorizing the issuance of bonds or the trust agreement.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(bb)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Refunding bonds.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may issue bonds to refund outstanding bonds of the Authority, including paying:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>any redemption premium;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>interest accrued or to accrue to the date of redemption, purchase, or maturity of the bonds; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>if considered advisable by the Authority, any part of the cost of acquiring or improving property as part of a project.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>Refunding bonds may be issued for any corporate purpose, including:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>realizing savings in the effective costs of debt service, directly or through a debt restructuring; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>alleviating a potential or actual default.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>A refunding bond that the Authority issues under this subsection shall be issued in the same manner and is subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> to the same extent as any other bond.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may issue refunding bonds in one or more series in an amount greater than the amount of the bonds to be refunded.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(cc)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Bond anticipation notes.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may issue negotiable bond anticipation notes in anticipation of the sale of bonds for any corporate purpose.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Bond anticipation notes issued under this subsection shall be issued in the same manner as bonds.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>Bond anticipation notes issued under this subsection and the resolution authorizing them may contain any provisions, conditions, or limitations that may be included in a trust agreement.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may issue bond anticipation notes to pay any other bond anticipation notes.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>Bond anticipation notes shall be paid from:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>revenues of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>money available and not otherwise pledged; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the proceeds of the sale of the bonds in anticipation of which the notes were issued.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(dd)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Conveyance of title.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall convey title to property relating to a project and release collateral in accordance with this subsection when the following conditions are met:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>the principal of and interest on bonds issued to finance the project, including any refunding bonds, have been fully paid and retired; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>adequate provision has been made to fully pay and retire the bonds;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>all other conditions of the trust agreement have been satisfied; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>the lien of the trust agreement has been released.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>On satisfaction of the conditions under paragraph (1) of this subsection, the Authority promptly shall execute any deeds, conveyances, releases, and documents and take any other action necessary to convey title to the property and release collateral free of all liens and encumbrances created through the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ee)</span></p>
<p>
          Protection and enforcement of bondholders’, etc., rights,
        </p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>A bondholder, a holder of any coupons attached to bonds, or a trustee under a trust agreement securing the bonds may sue to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>protect and enforce rights under laws of the State or a trust agreement; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>enforce and compel the performance of duties by the Authority or its officer, employee, or agent that <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">this section</a> or a trust agreement requires, including fixing and collecting rates, rents, fees, and charges that the trust agreement requires to be fixed and collected.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The rights under this subsection are subject to any trust agreement.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 624, Acts of 2009</p>
```


### § (66). Community Benefits District Authority – East Baltimore. {#s-66}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Definitions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<p>In <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> the following words have the meanings indicated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Authority.</span></p>
<p>“Authority” means the Community Benefits District Authority created in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> and any ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Board.</span></p>
<p>“Board” means the Board of Directors of the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">District.</span></p>
<p>“District” means a community benefits district created in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> and any ordinance enacted in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">District taxes.</span></p>
<p>“District taxes” means the taxes and other charges in the nature of property taxes that are authorized in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> and any ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">East Baltimore section.</span></p>
<p>“East Baltimore section” means that portion of Baltimore City generally bounded:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>on the west, by the westernmost property line of the properties facing Broadway;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>on the north, by the right–of–way of the railroad corridor used by Amtrak;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>on the east, by the easternmost property line of the properties facing Patterson Park Avenue; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>on the south, by the middle of Madison Street.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Property tax.</span></p>
<p>“Property tax” has the same meaning as stated in <a href="article-gtp.html#s-1-101">§ 1-101 of the Tax-Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Ordinance to establish District and Authority.</span></p>
<p>Subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (n) of this section</a>, the City may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>establish, by ordinance, a District within the East Baltimore Section of the City of Baltimore to be a special tax district and to provide services consistent with item (2) of this subsection to the businesses and residents of the proposed district; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>establish, by ordinance, an Authority to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>administer the programs and activities to be conducted by the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>promote and market the District;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>provide supplemental security and maintenance services;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>provide amenities in public areas;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>provide park and recreational programs and functions; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>provide other services and functions as approved by an ordinance of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, provided that the services and functions shall be provided within the District, or, to the extent authorized, within areas adjacent or adjoining to the District.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Elements of ordinance; District taxes.</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the District and the Authority shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>specify the name for the District and the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>specify the method for establishing and modifying the boundaries of the District, which may include methods by which:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>property owners may petition to be included in the District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>property owners, tenants, or residents of blocks or portions of blocks {may?} conduct a referendum to be included in the District;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>specify the powers and functions within the limits of <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> that may be exercised by the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>authorize the imposition of district taxes as the primary means of support for the District and specify any limits on the district taxes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>specify the duration of the District and the Authority, or the means by which the continuance of the District and the Authority may be the subject of a further ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>provide for the collection of district taxes and for the prompt disbursement of the revenue to the Authority subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (e) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>determine whether classes and subclasses of property in the District may be established and the extent to which each class or subclass shall be subject to or exempt from district taxes or varying rates of district taxes and the extent to which specific areas of the District may exercise discretion as to the use of district taxes generated by the areas;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>specify the method for determining district taxes to be imposed on classes and subclasses of property under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>, including the creation of credits against district taxes to assist low–income families;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>specify the extent to which the Authority may provide additional services for a fee either within or outside the District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>determine the organization and method of initial appointment of officers and board members of the Authority, subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (f) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Financial plan required.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall establish a financial plan for the District when required by an ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The financial plan, including its annual budget, district tax rates, and schedule of other fees and charges, shall be subject to approval by the Board of Estimates.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The financial plan may include provisions for allocating resources to the particular needs of the District, including allocations to particular sections of the District or to particular uses within the District.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Public hearing on financial plan; Exemptions from district taxes.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Before adopting its proposed budget and making its recommendations to the City, the Authority shall hold a public hearing on the financial plan proposed for the District.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall publish notice of the hearing under paragraph (1) of this subsection in a newspaper of general circulation in Baltimore City at least once a week for 3 consecutive weeks before the hearing.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>Property in the District that is exempt under State law from ordinary property taxes shall be exempt from district taxes.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>The Authority may request the owners of property exempt from taxes under paragraph (3) of this subsection to voluntarily contribute to the costs of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Board of Directors.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The governing body of the Authority shall be the Board of Directors.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Each voting member of the Board shall be an owner, or, when the owner is a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, trust, or any other legal entity, representatives of owners of properties in the District that are subject to district taxes under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> may establish two or more classes of Board members and may require certain actions to be made subject to the approval of each class of board members.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers and duties of Authority.</span></p>
<p>As provided by an ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>, the Authority may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>conduct the functions that are assigned to the Authority by the ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>acquire, hold, and use property necessary to achieve the Authority’s purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>enter into contracts;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>sue and be sued, subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (h) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>borrow and accept grants;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>employ and discharge personnel;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>propose in the authority’s annual budget the district taxes in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (e) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>adopt, amend, and modify bylaws, all of which shall be subject to the approval of the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>establish and elect officers, and provide for terms of office and the duties of the officers;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>contract for and purchase goods and services in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (i) of this section</a>; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(11)</span></p>
<p>do all things necessary or convenient to carry out the Authority’s powers and obligations under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> and the ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Governmental immunity for Authority and District administrators.</span></p>
<p>The District, the Authority, the Board, and any administrator of the District shall benefit, to the fullest extent allowable by law, from all provisions of federal, state, and local law limiting the liability of employees, officers, agents, and officials of governmental units.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Application of MBE/WBE Program.</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall be subject to City ordinances and City policy requiring achievement of goals regarding minority and women’s business enterprises.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Limitations on Authority’s powers and duties.</span></p>
<p>The Authority may not:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>exercise any police or general powers other than those authorized by State law and City ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>pledge the full faith or credit of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>impose taxes or charges in excess of those approved by the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>exercise the power of eminent domain;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>engage in competition with the private sector, except as otherwise provided by law, and as necessary to exercise the powers provided for under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> and in any ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>except as otherwise provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">subsection (m) of this section</a>, revert charges or taxes collected in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> to the General Fund of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>be an agency of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland, and its officers and employees may not act as agents or employees of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>employ individuals who reside outside the City of Baltimore; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>except as required or appropriate to facilitate its normal operations or to the extent permitted by an ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>, incur debt.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Prerequisites for establishing District and Authority.</span></p>
<p>Before enacting an ordinance under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>provide for public hearings during which consideration is given to the views of the property owners, retail merchants, property tenants, and other members of the business and residential communities within the proposed district;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that the proposed district created reflects a diverse mix of business and residential properties; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that the proposed district reflects a diverse economic, social, and racial mix among its residents and within the working population employed in the proposed district.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(l)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City services not to be reduced.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may not permit a reduction in the services provided by the City in the District due to the establishment of the District or the Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(m)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Unspent funds on dissolution.</span></p>
<p>In the event of a dissolution of the District or the Authority, any unspent funds shall revert back to the City’s General Fund.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(n)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Process for approving District and Authority.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a> shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>establish the process for the approval of the creation of the District and the Authority; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>provide that until the approval process is conducted and approval is achieved under the process the District and the Authority may not be created, and the ordinance may not become fully effective.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance may provide:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>criteria for the eligibility of voters for purposes of the election required by the ordinance; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>procedures for a special election required in this subsection, which may be administered by write-in ballots.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>Editor's Notes, History:</strong> Ch. 645, Acts of 2010; Chapter 645, Acts of 2010, which enacted <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">this section</a>, designated it as <a href="article-ii.html#s-65">Article II, § (65)</a>.  Inasmuch as § (65) was already occupied, the new section is codified here as <a href="article-ii.html#s-66">Article II, § (66)</a>.</p>
```


### § (67). Investment in Our Youth (IO-YOUth) Pilot Program. {#s-67}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Definitions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<p>In <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">this section</a> the following words have the meanings indicated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Employer.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">General.</span></p>
<p>“Employer” has the meaning stated in § 3401 of the internal revenue code.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Inclusions.</span></p>
<p>“Employer” includes:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>the State and its units;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>a county and its units; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">3.</span></p>
<p>a municipal government in the State.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Nonprofit organization.</span></p>
<p>“Nonprofit organization” means an organization that is exempt from taxation under § 501 of the Internal Revenue 10 Code.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Program.</span></p>
<p>“Program” means the Investment in Our Youth (IO–YOUth) pilot program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Summer.</span></p>
<p>“Summer” means the period from June 1 to September 30, inclusive, of each year.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Establishment of Program.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may establish an Investment in Our Youth (IO–YOUth) Pilot Program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The program shall be established as a qualified organization eligible to receive tax–deductible charitable contributions under § 170(c) of the Internal Revenue Code.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The purpose of the Program is to provide summer jobs for youths who are at least 14 years old and not more than 18 years old.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>The Program shall provide summer jobs for youths by:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>hiring youths to work during the summer for the City of Baltimore; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>providing grants to nonprofit organizations that will provide summer jobs for youths.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall establish a committee to carry out the Program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall establish a procedure for the disposition of any funds remaining in the Program in the event that the Program is terminated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>To be eligible for a grant from the Program, a nonprofit organization shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>operate within the City of Baltimore; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>meet any other requirement established under the Program.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>A nonprofit organization that receives a grant from the Program may not use the grant to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>employ youths who do not reside in the City of Baltimore; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>provide jobs at sites that are located outside of the City of Baltimore.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Tax-deductible contributions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Nothing in this paragraph may be construed to require an employer to make a deduction from the wage of an employee.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>On written request of an employee, an employer may make a deduction from the wage of an employee for the benefit of the Program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The written request provided by an employee under subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph shall include the amount of the deduction.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>An employer shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>distribute quarterly to the City of Baltimore any funds deducted by the employer from the wage of an employee; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>report quarterly to the City of Baltimore the name, address, and other information provided by the employee under <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">subsection (c)(1) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The amount of funds distributed to the City of Baltimore under subparagraph (i) of this paragraph shall equal the amount of funds deducted from the wages of employees who have submitted a written request as provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">subsection (c)(1) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Except as provided in subparagraph (ii) of this paragraph, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall pay the funds into the special fund established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">subsection (d) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>If the Program has ended, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall follow the procedure for the disposition of funds remaining in the Program as provided under <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">subsection (a)(6) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>The City of Baltimore may receive a direct donation from a person for the benefit of the Program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The City of Baltimore shall provide a receipt to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>each employee whose information was  reported to the City of Baltimore by the employer under paragraph (2) of this subsection; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>each person from which the City of Baltimore receives a direct donation under paragraph (4) of this subsection.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>A receipt provided by the City of Baltimore under subparagraph (i) of this paragraph shall include a statement that the amount of the deduction from the employee’s wages or the amount of the donation is tax-deductible under § 170(c) of the Internal Revenue Code.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Special fund.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall establish a special fund to be used to fund the Program.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Program shall be funded by:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>funds distributed to the City of Baltimore under <a href="article-ii.html#s-67">subsection (c) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>funds appropriated to the Program by the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>donations received by the City of Baltimore to be used for the Program.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>Funds in the special fund may be used only for funding the Program.</p>
</div>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>Editor's Notes, History:</strong> Ch.  655, Acts of 2012; Chapter 655, Acts of 2012, authorized this pilot program, effective for a 3-year period from October 1, 2012, through September 30, 2015.</p>
```


### § (68). Maryland Public Ethics Law. {#s-68}

```{=html}
<p>To exercise the power and authority contained in Title 5, Subtitle 8, Part II of the <a href="article-ggp.html">General Provisions Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a>.</p>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 104, Acts of 2014</p>
```


### § (69). South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Authority. {#s-69}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">In general.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>To establish, by ordinance, the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District within the City to provide services consistent with paragraph (2) of this subsection to the business interests and residents of the proposed district.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>To establish the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority to promote and market the District, provide supplemental security and maintenance services, provide amenities in public areas, provide park and recreational programs and functions, and after the Authority is established, other services and functions as requested by the Authority and approved through an ordinance by the Mayor and City Council.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Boundaries.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority shall specify and modify the boundaries of the District, but in no event shall the District be outside the lines, as follows:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>on the south, a line beginning at the intersection of the city line and the center line of the Patapsco River, running north along the center line of the Patapsco River to Hanover Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>running north along Hanover Street to McComas Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>running east along McComas Street to the center line of Key Highway; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>running northeast along the center line of Key Highway to the center line of East Fort Avenue; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>running southeast along the center line of East Fort Avenue to the center line of Stevenson Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>running northeast along the center line of Stevenson Street to the center line of Key Highway; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of Key Highway to the center line of Light Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of Light Street to the center line of East Conway Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of East Conway Street to the center line of South Howard Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of South Howard Street to the center line of West Camden Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of West Camden Street to the center line of Washington Boulevard; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xii)</span></p>
<p>running southwest along the center line of Washington Boulevard to the center line of South Greene Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiii)</span></p>
<p>running north along South Greene Street to the center line of West Pratt Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xiv)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of West Pratt Street to the center line of South Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xv)</span></p>
<p>running north along the center line of South Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard to the center line of West Lombard Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xvi)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of West Lombard Street to the center line of Scott Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xvii)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Scott Street to the center line of Pratt Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xviii)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of Pratt Street to the center line of Carey Street; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xix)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Carey Street to the center line of the tracks of the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xx)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of the tracks of the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad to the Gwynns Falls; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xxi)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of the Gwynns Falls to the center line of Washington Boulevard; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
```
