```{=html}
<p><span class="charter-num">(xxii)</span></p>
<p>running west along the center line of Washington Boulevard to the center line of Hollins Ferry Road; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xxiii)</span></p>
<p>running south along the center line of Hollins Ferry Road to the center line of the tracks of the CSX Railroad; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xxiv)</span></p>
<p>running southwest along the center line of the tracks of the CSX Railroad to the city line; then</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xxv)</span></p>
<p>running southeast along the city line to the center line of the Patapsco River (point of origin).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Notwithstanding paragraph (1) of this subsection, the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District shall include properties within the Saint Paul, Mount Winans, Lakeland, Cherry Hill, Westport, Carroll Park, Carroll–Camden Industrial Area, Pigtown/Washington Village, Barre Circle, Ridgely’s Delight, Otterbein, Federal Hill, Riverside, South Baltimore, Stadium Area, Spring Garden Industrial Area, Middle Branch/Reedbird Parks, and Westport Neighborhood Statistical Areas according to the 2011 Neighborhood Statistical Areas Map.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Scope of establishing ordinance.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority shall address the following:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>specify the powers and functions within the limits of <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">this section</a>, which may be exercised and conducted by the Authority and provide that the State fund the Authority with not less than the 50% of the local impact grants from video lottery proceeds that <a href="article-gsg.html#s-9-1">§ 9-1A-31(a)(3)(i) of the State Government Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland</a> requires the State to distribute directly to the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>specify the duration of the Authority and define the boundaries of the District;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>subject to paragraph (2) of this subsection, provide for the disbursement of the revenue from local impact grants to the Authority; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>subject to paragraph (3) of this subsection, determine the organization and method of initial appointment of officers and board members of the Authority.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The financial plan of the Authority, including its annual budget, shall be subject to approval by the Board of Estimates.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>The board shall consist of not more than 21 members.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The majority of the members of the board shall be residents of the District.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall be chaired by an individual appointed by the State Senator who represents the legislative district where the video lottery facility is located.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>Subject to subparagraph (vi) of this paragraph, the Authority’s board shall include four members designated by the Speaker of the House.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>Subject to subparagraph (vi) of this paragraph, two members of the Authority’s board shall be designated by the State Senator who represents the legislative district where the video lottery facility is located.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>Of the six members designated under subparagraphs (iv) and (v) of this paragraph:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">1.</span></p>
<p>at least two members shall be residents of the 40th Legislative District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-4">
<p><span class="charter-num">2.</span></p>
<p>at least two members shall be residents of the 46th Legislative District.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers of Authority.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority may authorize the Authority to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>be a special impact district and to conduct the functions which are assigned to it by the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>acquire, hold, and use property necessary to achieve its purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>make contracts;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>sue and be sued;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>borrow and accept grants for purposes consistent with the purposes of the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>employ and discharge personnel to carry out its public purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>subject to paragraph (2) of this subsection, propose in its annual budget the allocation of local impact grants distributed to the Authority;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>adopt, amend, and modify bylaws, all of which shall be subject to the approval of the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>establish and elect officers and provide for their terms and duties;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>subject to City ordinances and City policy requiring achievement of goals regarding Minority and Women’s Business Enterprises but not to the City requirements regarding wage scales, competitive bidding, or other local procurement laws, contract for and purchase goods and services; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(xi)</span></p>
<p>do all things necessary or convenient to carry out its powers.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>Before adopting its proposed budget and making its recommendations to the City, the Authority shall hold a public hearing on the allocations proposed for the District.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>The Authority shall publish notice of the hearing on the Website of the Authority for 3 consecutive weeks before the hearing.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Limitations on Authority.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">this section</a> may not:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>exercise any police or general powers other than those authorized by State law and City ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>pledge the full faith or credit of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>impose any taxes or charges;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>exercise the power of eminent domain;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>extend its life without the approval of the City Council;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vi)</span></p>
<p>except as otherwise provided by law, engage in competition with the private sector;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(vii)</span></p>
<p>except as provided in <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">subsection (j) of this section</a>, revert local impact grants to the General Fund of the City;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(viii)</span></p>
<p>be an agency of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ix)</span></p>
<p>employ individuals who reside outside the City of Baltimore; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(x)</span></p>
<p>except as required or appropriate to facilitate its normal operations, incur debt.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>An officer or employee of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority created under <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">this section</a> may not act, in the officer’s or employee’s capacity for the Authority, as an agent or employee of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Considerations.</span></p>
<p>In adopting an ordinance, the City Council shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>give consideration to the views of the property owners, the retail merchants, the property tenants, and the other members of the business and residential communities within the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District will reflect:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>a diverse mix of business and residential properties; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>a diverse economic, social, and racial mix.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Periodic review – General.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council shall review the effectiveness and desirability of continuing the existence of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">this section</a> every 4 years from the enactment of the ordinance.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Periodic review – Specific.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council shall review and determine the desirability of continuing the existence of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District established under <a href="article-ii.html#s-69">this section</a> every 4 years beginning 4 years after the date of the establishment of the District.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>If the continuing existence of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District is not approved:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the District shall cease to exist at the end of the City’s fiscal year in which approval was not granted; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority shall continue its existence only as long as necessary to terminate operations in a reasonable manner and to arrange for the disposition of all funds not needed to satisfy outstanding obligations and reserves for uncertain obligations and liabilities.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City not to reduce services.</span></p>
<p>The Mayor and City Council may not permit a reduction in the services provided by the City in the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District due to the establishment of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District Management Authority.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Dissolution.</span></p>
<p>In the event of a dissolution of the South Baltimore Gateway Community Impact District, any unspent funds shall revert back to the City’s General Fund.</p>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Ch. 314, Acts of 2016; Ch. 751, Acts of 2018</p>
```


### § (70). Tourism Improvement District. {#s-70}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Definitions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>In <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> the following words have the meanings indicated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>“Association” means an existing private nonprofit destination marketing organization that promotes tourism to Baltimore City and the convention center in order to increase the number of visitors to the City that is designated as the Tourism Improvement District Association in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> and any ordinance enacted in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>“Board” means the Board of Directors of the Association.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>“Business” means a hotel as defined in the Baltimore City Code.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>“District” means a Tourism Improvement District created in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>“District special assessment” means a special assessment that is authorized under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> and any ordinance enacted in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Establishment by ordinance.</span></p>
<p>Subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">subsection (m) of this section</a>, the City may enact an ordinance to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>establish a Tourism Improvement District to support marketing, sales, and other promotional programs and activities to increase tourism in the District or specifically benefit those participating businesses against which a district special assessment is made; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>designate an existing private nonprofit entity as the Association to:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>administer the District programs and activities;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>promote and market the District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>provide other services and functions as approved By an ordinance of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore, provided that the services and functions shall be provided within the District, or, to the extent authorized, within areas adjoining or adjacent to the District.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Scope of ordinance – In general.</span></p>
<p>The ordinance establishing the District and designating the Association shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>specify the name for the District and the Association;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>specify the method for establishing and modifying the boundaries of the District, which may include methods by which:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>business owners may petition to be included in the District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>business owners may conduct a referendum to be included in the district;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>specify the powers and functions within the limits of <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> that may be exercised by the Association;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>authorize the imposition of district special assessments levied on businesses within the District as the primary means of support for the District and specify any limits on the district special assessments;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>specify the duration of the District and the power of the Association to act, or the means by which the continuance of the District may be the subject of a further ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>provide for the collection of district special assessments and for the prompt disbursement of the revenue to the association;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>determine whether classes and subclasses of businesses in the District may be established and the extent to which each class or subclass shall be subject to or exempt from district special assessments or varying rates of district special assessments and the extent to which specific areas of the District may exercise discretion as to the use of district special assessments generated by the areas;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>specify the method for determining district special assessments to be imposed on classes and subclasses of businesses under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>specify the extent to which the Association may provide additional services for a fee either within or outside the District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>specify the criteria for representation on the Association’s Board of Directors or district management committee, subject to <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">subsection (f) of this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Financial plan – In general.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Association shall establish a financial plan for the District when required by an ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The financial plan, including the District’s annual budget and district special assessments, shall be subject to approval by the Board of Estimates.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The financial plan may include provisions for allocating resources to the particular needs of the District, including allocations to particular sections of the District or to particular uses within the District.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Financial plan – Public hearing.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Before adopting its proposed budget and making its recommendations to the City, the Association shall hold a public hearing on the financial plan proposed for the District.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Association shall publish notice of the hearing under paragraph (1) of this subsection in a newspaper of general circulation in Baltimore City at least once a week for 3 consecutive weeks before the hearing, and provide an opportunity to submit public testimony to the Association.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Board of Directors.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The governing body of the Association shall be the Board of Directors.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>A majority of the voting members of the Board or members of the committee managing the District funds shall be owners, or, when the owner is a corporation, limited liability company, partnership, trust, or any other legal entity, representatives of the owners of a business in the District that is subject to district special assessments under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> may require the establishment of an Association committee to manage the District funds and may require certain actions to be made subject to the approval of the committee.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Powers of Association.</span></p>
<p>As provided by an ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>, the Association may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>conduct the functions that are assigned to the Association by the ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>acquire, hold, and use property necessary to achieve the District’s purposes;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>enter into contracts for the provision of District services;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>sue and be sued, subject to subsection (h) {sic} of <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>borrow and accept grants;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>employ and discharge personnel;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(7)</span></p>
<p>propose, in the District’s annual budget, the district special assessments in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">subsection (d) of this section</a>;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(8)</span></p>
<p>adopt, amend, and modify bylaws, all of which shall be subject to the approval of the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(9)</span></p>
<p>establish and elect officers, and provide for the terms of office and the duties of the officers;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(10)</span></p>
<p>contract for and purchase goods and services in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">subsection (h) of this section</a>; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(11)</span></p>
<p>do all things necessary or convenient to carry out the purposes of the District under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> and the ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Compliance with goals for minority and women’s business enterprises.</span></p>
<p>The Association shall be subject to City ordinances and City policy requiring achievement of goals regarding minority and women’s business enterprises.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Limitations.</span></p>
<p>The Association may not:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>exercise any police or general powers other than those authorized by State law and City ordinance;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>pledge the full faith or credit of the city;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>impose district special assessments in excess of those approved by the Board of Estimates;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>exercise the power of eminent domain;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(5)</span></p>
<p>revert charges or district special assessments collected in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> to the General Fund of the City; or</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(6)</span></p>
<p>be an agency of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland, and its officers and employees may not act as agents or employees of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore or the State of Maryland.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Public hearings; Considerations.</span></p>
<p>Before enacting an ordinance under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a>, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>provide for public hearings during which consideration is given to the views of the business owners that will be subject to district special assessments within the proposed District; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>make a determination that the proposed District created includes those businesses that will benefit from District services.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">City not to reduce existing funding.</span></p>
<p>To the extent of their authority, the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore may not permit a reduction in existing funding provided by the City in the District due to the establishment of the District or the designation of the Association.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(l)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Dissolution.</span></p>
<p>In the event of a dissolution of the District or the Association, any unspent funds shall be refunded to the business owners by applying the same method and basis that was used to calculate the district special assessments that were levied.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(m)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Scope of ordinance – Establish approval process.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>An ordinance enacted under <a href="article-ii.html#s-70">this section</a> shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>establish the process for the approval of the creation of the District and the designation of the Association; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>provide that, until the approval process is conducted and approval is achieved under the process, the district may not be created, and the ordinance may not become fully effective.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The ordinance may provide:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>criteria for the eligibility of voters for purposes of the election required by the ordinance; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>procedures for a special election required in this subsection, which may be administered by write-in ballots.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>History:</strong> Chs. 641 and 642, Acts of 2018</p>
```


### § (71). Commission to Restore Trust in Policing. {#s-71}

```{=html}
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(a)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Definitions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>In <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">this section</a> the following words have the meanings indicated.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>“Commission” means the Commission to Restore Trust in Policing.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>“Police Department” means the Baltimore Police Department.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>“Task Force” means the Baltimore Police Department’s Gun Trace Task Force.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(b)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Commission established.</span></p>
<p>There is a Commission to Restore Trust in Policing.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(c)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Members.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>The Commission consists of the following members:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>two individuals appointed by the President of the Senate;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>two individuals appointed by the Speaker of the House; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>two individuals appointed by the Governor.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Four members of the Commission shall possesses a Juris Doctor and have litigation experience.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>Three members of the Commission shall be Baltimore City residents.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(d)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Chair.</span></p>
<p>The Governor, the President of the Senate, and the Speaker of the House shall jointly appoint and designate the Chair of the Commission.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(e)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Staff.</span></p>
<p>The Department of Legislative Services shall provide staff for the Commission.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(f)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Compensation; Expenses.</span></p>
<p>A member of the Commission:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>may not receive compensation as a member of the Commission; but</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>is entitled to reimbursement for expenses under the Standard State Travel Regulations, as provided in the State budget.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(g)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Duties.</span></p>
<p>The Commission shall:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>review the operation of the Task Force, including:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>the Task Force’s establishment, personnel, and oversight;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>investigations and cases handled by the Task Force;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>any federal criminal investigations and cases relating to the Task Force and its members; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>any violations of existing departmental policies and procedures related to the conduct of the Task Force;</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>utilize various methods of investigation and information gathering, including reviewing of transcripts or other sworn testimony, collecting and analyzing documents, interviewing of witnesses through subpoena or other means, and any other reasonable means;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>with consideration of the Commission’s findings and the 2017 Federal Consent Decree between Baltimore City, the Police Department, and the U.S. Department of Justice, make recommendations regarding:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span></p>
<p>whether a reorganization of the Police Department is warranted and, if so, options for reorganization;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(ii)</span></p>
<p>best practices regarding the establishment and oversight of specialized units, similar to the Task Force, within law enforcement agencies;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iii)</span></p>
<p>Ongoing State and City oversight of the Police Department;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(iv)</span></p>
<p>whether there exist any legal impediments to the Police Department effectively managing and disciplining sworn officers; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-3">
<p><span class="charter-num">(v)</span></p>
<p>any other matters relating to the Commission’s findings.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(h)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Public information; exceptions.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>Except as provided under the Public Information Act and the Open Meetings Act, the proceedings, testimony, and any other evidence before the commission are public information.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>Members of the Commission and staff to the Commission may not be required to sign a confidentiality agreement to receive documents or files, including personnel files, properly subpoenaed in accordance with <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">this section</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(i)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Hearings.</span></p>
<p>The Commission may:</p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>conduct hearings;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>administer oaths and affirmations;</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>issue process to compel the attendance of witnesses and the production of evidence; and</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>require a person to testify and produce evidence.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(j)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Subpoenas.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>A subpoena may be served in the same manner as one issued by a circuit court.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Commission may immediately report the failure of a person to obey a lawfully served subpoena to the circuit court of the county having jurisdiction.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(3)</span></p>
<p>The Commission shall provide a copy of the subpoena and proof of service to the circuit court.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(4)</span></p>
<p>After conducting a hearing at which the person who allegedly failed to comply with a subpoena has an opportunity to be heard and represented by counsel, the court may grant appropriate relief.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(k)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Right to attorney.</span></p>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(1)</span></p>
<p>A person may have an attorney present during any contact with the Commission.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-2">
<p><span class="charter-num">(2)</span></p>
<p>The Commission shall advise a person of the right to counsel when a subpoena is served.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(l)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Preliminary report.</span></p>
<p>On or before December 31, 2018, the Commission shall submit a preliminary report of its initial findings, conclusions, and recommendations to the Governor and, in accordance with § 2-1246 of the State Government Article, the General Assembly.</p>
</div>
<div class="charter-para charter-depth-1">
<p><span class="charter-num">(m)</span> <span class="charter-subhead">Final report.</span></p>
<p>On or before December 31, 2020, the Commission shall submit a final report of its findings, conclusions, and recommendations to the Governor and, in accordance with § 2-1246 of the State Government Article, the General Assembly.</p>
</div>
<p class="charter-history"><strong>Editor's Notes, History:</strong> Ch. 753, Acts of 2018; Chs. 459 and 460, Acts of 2019; 
          <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">This section</a> was abrogated effective January 15, 2021, and is no longer of any force or effect. The text of this section is retained below for historical reference notwithstanding its abrogation.
          <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">This section</a> was enacted by Ch. 753, Acts of 2018, effective May 15, 2018. Section 4 of that Act made the enactment subject to a sunset clause under which the section would terminate on its own terms, with no further action by the General Assembly required. Chs. 459 and 460, Acts of 2019, amended <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">subsections (h)</a> and <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">(m)</a> of <a href="article-ii.html#s-71">this section</a> and, in the same Acts, extended that sunset period from 1 year and 8 months to 2 years and 8 months from the date of original enactment, which fixed the abrogation date above.
        </p>
```
